question: For sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 11% and 28 C under the applied magnetic field, what share formed coffee rings and what was the average ring diameter?
rendered: Based on the document "Evaporative Crystallization of Sodium Chlorate Droplets under Controlled Humidity in the Presence of a Static Magnetic Field" the share of coffee-ring deposits at RH ≈ 11% and T = 28 °C under the applied magnetic field was 73.3%. The average coffee-ring diameter was approximately 2.25 ± 0.07 mm.
